title: Active and passive
goal: Say what was done when the doer doesn’t matter
wm: The Verb: Active and Passive Voice
intro: In the active voice, the doer comes first: “Someone stole my bike.” In the passive, the thing that the action happened to comes first: “My bike was stolen.” Use the passive when the doer is unknown, unimportant, or obvious. Form: be + past participle.

examples: The road was repaired last week.

rules.rule: Add “by” only if the doer matters.
examples: This book was written by Tagore.

mistakes.wrong: The work is complete by tomorrow.
mistakes.right: The work will be completed by tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Future passive: will be + past participle.

ex.q: Rice ___ in many parts of India.
The window was broke by the kids.
ex.fixed: The window was broken by the kids.
My car was stolen last night.

ex.a: The report will be sent on Monday.

ex.q: Make it passive: “They cancelled the flight.”

talk: Describe your city or a famous building: when it was built, what it is known for, and what is being done there now. Use the passive at least four times.
